protocol.disclosure: Retrospective correction after inspecting stage18 labels and results; frozen before this version's new fits, not prospective preregistration.
protocol.baseline: retained699: exclude retracted source only, retain binary conflicts
protocol.sensitivity: exclude693: exclude binary-conflicting composition/input groups within retained699; no multiclass-only exclusions
protocol.primary_evaluation: Both training policies predict exactly the same held-out 699 rows using original group folds. Six conflict rows remain in evaluation.
protocol.secondary_evaluation: Common693 subset excluding six binary-conflict records; conditional evaluation, not a replacement for full699 results.
protocol.exclusion_interpretation: Conflict exclusion is a sensitivity analysis, not proof of erroneous labels or existing split leakage.
protocol.features: Original2280 measured/declared-input legacy features; not complete molecular recipes. Missing quantities are not newly repaired or certified.
protocol.split: Reuse stage3 outer5 and inner3 group folds; filter training pool only; preserve original row order.
protocol.preprocessing: Fit imputer, missing indicators, constant filter on training only, as in stage5 baseline.
protocol.secondary_threshold: Balanced-accuracy threshold selected only from outer-training inner OOF predictions.
protocol.final_model_threshold: Fixed0.5 research default; no threshold selected from outer evaluation labels.
protocol.paired_comparison: exclude693 minus retained699 on identical evaluation rows and paired group bootstrap weights
protocol.bootstrap_scope: Fixed OOF predictions only; no refit or split uncertainty; no equivalence/noninferiority claim.
protocol.cosmetics_scope: Correct unique formulation counts, retain descriptive associations, re-evaluate uncertainty of historical fixed LOO scores with recipe-family bootstrap; no new cosmetics model or external-validation claim.
protocol.cosmetics_limitations: Historical full-cohort token selection and pooled LOO remain exploratory; grouped bootstrap does not cure LOO bias; no year-stratum biological reversal claim.
